keyEvents.text: Goal! Werder Bremen 1, RB Leipzig 0. Eren Dinkçi (Werder Bremen) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Chuki with a through ball.
Chuki (Werder Bremen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Werder Bremen 1, RB Leipzig 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Karl Hein (Werder Bremen).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Tidiam Gomis replaces Johan Bakayoko.
Substitution, Werder Bremen. Mick Schmetgens replaces Arthur.
Substitution, Werder Bremen. Paul Erevbenagie replaces Eren Dinkçi because of an injury.
Goal! Werder Bremen 2, RB Leipzig 0. Niclas Füllkrug (Werder Bremen) header from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Marco Grüll with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Werder Bremen. Cedric Itten replaces Niclas Füllkrug.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Marc Guiu replaces Neil El Aynaoui.
Goal! Werder Bremen 3, RB Leipzig 0. Marco Grüll (Werder Bremen) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
